## (3) New findings

### Blocker B-ME — the dry-run's labels AS THE ARENA HOLDS the parts are unpinned (CONFIRMED)

Mutant ME (kerb.ts `dryRegion`, :1065): `const cycles = d.laid.map((l) => cycleOf(p, l, role));` → `const cycles =
d.clipped.map((r) => r.map((q) => ({ x: q.x as number, y: q.y as number })));` — every face of the dry-run labelled by
its winding against the parts' CLIPPED INPUT rings instead of the cycles of edges the arena holds for them. Q18's
required change states the construction in these words: "labelled … against every part AS THE ARENA HOLDS IT — the
cycle of edges carrying the part's row from `ChainInsert.placed`, never the input ring, which attraction may have moved
(a sliver labelled from the input is a silently wrong kerb, N-45 (a))"; kerb.ts's header (:38) and C-0387 restate it.

So ME changes committed results on honest inputs of the item's own family (a face read as all band where the arena
holds the part elsewhere — the hazard the stated construction exists to exclude) and no test of the item sees it at
10⁴: the promise is unpinned. By the brief's rule a survivor on a stated promise the checker does not find equivalent
is a blocker. The tree's reading is the ruled one (the commit lays the same parts and holds them the same way, so
S8 ≡ S9 holds only with the held cycles); the blocker is the missing pin, not the engine.

**Required change (lane `build/M0-a-09-fix-s10` or as the session names it):** one test red under ME and green on the
tree, inside the item's owns — e.g. in `corridor.test.ts` or `dryrun.test.ts`, the networks above (seed 20261011 draws
275 and 532, or the chords quoted, as fixed cases) asserting face 2's kerb is the recorded corner triangle and that
corridorUnion's committed blocks tile it (S8 ≡ S9 on that face); or a hand-built case with a part whose held cycle
leaves a face out that its clipped input ring covers (a part's run end attracted or placed off the input, the face
between the input edge and the held edge labelled by the held cycle). The self-check re-introduces ME and records the
red; the closing checker re-kills it. No engine change is asked.
